detailed_findings.finding: The proof correctly shows k_r cannot be 0 because that would place a positive element of S below the multiplicity m.
The proof correctly establishes the exact membership pattern in each residue class r modulo m: numbers below w_r are gaps and all numbers at or above w_r in that class are in S.

The final counting argument is complete: the residue classes modulo m form a disjoint partition of N0, class 0 contributes no gaps since m in S implies all multiples of m lie in S, and each nonzero class contributes exactly k_r gaps.

reason: The proof correctly partitions N0 \ S by residue classes modulo m and shows that in each nonzero class r there are exactly k_r gaps, namely r, r+m, ..., r+(k_r-1)m, while the zero class contributes none. The argument that k_r > 0 uses minimality of m correctly, and the argument that all larger elements in the same residue class belong to S uses closure under addition with m. This matches the lemma sketch exactly and supports the intended Kunz-vector/genus correspondence used in the root theorem assembly.
